stock.description: Kunming Dianchi Water Treatment Co., Ltd., along with its various subsidiaries, is a comprehensive enterprise dedicated to water infrastructure development and management across the People's Republic of China. The company is involved in the entire lifecycle of water supply and wastewater treatment facilities, from their initial design and development to construction, operation, and ongoing maintenance. Its business activities are categorized into three main segments: Wastewater Treatment, Water Supply, and Other Services. A core aspect of its operations includes managing and running both wastewater and water supply facilities through concession agreements, specifically utilizing transfer-operate-transfer (TOT) and build-operate-transfer (BOT) models. Beyond these primary functions, the company's extensive service offerings encompass the provision of reclaimed water and potable tap water, municipal wastewater processing, and stringent water quality testing. Its diverse portfolio also extends to logistics, equipment leasing, professional training, and the manufacturing and sale of chemical products. Additionally, the company provides various management and transportation services, conducts watershed management, facilitates sludge recycling, undertakes mine restoration projects, and manages solid waste treatment and disposal. Involvement in thermal production activities further diversifies its operations. Founded in 1989, Kunming Dianchi Water Treatment Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Kunming, China, and functions as a subsidiary of Kunming Dianchi Investment Co., Ltd.
